task: D9.13 Closed-loop groups page uses the Manager API as the only business read and fails closed without legacy fallback
decision: The closed-loop groups GET route is manager-owned. Flask maps /v1/closed-loops loops and hops to the existing page DTO, including groups, summary, flashLoanToken metadata, routeCount, poolDependencyCount and include_routes projection. The route no longer reads legacy observation overview, static tables, cache or the closed_loop_route_groups_payload shadow path. When the manager response is unavailable, malformed, or scoped to another chain, Flask returns 503 manager_read_failed with dataSource=manager and no legacy fallback.
changes: /api/dex/closed-loop-groups calls closed_loop_manager_page_payload unconditionally and no longer invokes legacy observation overview or closed_loop_route_groups_payload
ClosedLoopSnapshot loops/hops are mapped to page groups, summary and compact include_routes projection; routePools are preview-only and do not affect closed-loop or PnL authority
flashLoanToken, startToken and endToken metadata come from ClosedLoopRow anchor metadata; routeCount and poolDependencyCount are derived from manager loops and poolIds
borrowableBasis=closed_loop_manager_anchor and summary.usdDepthRequired=false; no USD depth or USD TVL gate is introduced
snapshotLimited is set when loops exceed the manager snapshot limit; page group counts stay separate from full status counts
Manager response errors, missing arrays, invalid token fields and chain scope mismatch return 503 manager_read_failed with dataSource=manager; no legacy fallback
Architecture and workflow tests lock the closed-loop groups GET authority boundary and manager DTO contract

verification.note: D9.13 regression includes the closed-loop guard in this combined run

fixtures: Closed-loop manager DTO maps loops/hops into groups with flashLoanToken metadata, routeCount and deduplicated poolDependencyCount
include_routes=false returns compact groups and include_routes=true returns preview routePools projected from loop plus hop poolIds

Closed-loop groups route calls only closed_loop_manager_page_payload and returns 503 on manager failure
Closed-loop groups route never invokes legacy observation, cache or shadow opt-in
Web assembly workflow keeps the closed-loop groups route reachable and the manager-only DTO stable
knownBoundary: D9.13 covers code, tests, manager-only closed-loop groups GET and fail-closed behavior. It does not apply production manager data, start or stop the service, write the mainnet database, enable real broadcast, or change the closed-loop refresh/rebuild authority. /v1/closed-loops/compare remains diagnostic only. M5 production authority still requires M1-M4 real mainnet copy bootstrap and apply-window gates. No historical evidence was modified.
